markers.name: MARGIN_LETTER_LINE
markers.why: a single margin letter alone on a line — SCR/AIR column guides, never court prose

markers.name: PAGE_PARA_PINCITE
markers.why: reporter pin-cite to page and margin letter, e.g. [801-G-H; 802-A-B]

markers.name: HEADNOTE_BLOCK
markers.why: an explicit headnote heading — the reporter editor summarising the case

markers.name: PARA_CROSSREF
markers.why: editorial cross-reference into the judgment body, added by the reporter

markers.name: RUNNING_HEAD
markers.why: a page running head carrying the reporter name and year

markers.name: DISPOSAL_APPARATUS
markers.why: the reporter's standard jurisdiction banner above the case

scope_note: High Courts are a CONTROL group. If the markers fire at the same rate there, they are not detecting reporter apparatus.
caveats: apparatus_chars is a FLOOR. It counts margin-letter lines and pin-cite lines only; a headnote paragraph reads like prose and only its heading is structural.
no document is reclassified and nothing is written. This measures; it does not act.
precision against hand adjudication is NOT_MEASURED.
OFFICIAL_REPORTER classification of the SC corpus is asserted from R7 (35,570 of 38,342 carry a running head), not re-derived here.
